name: search_lost_sight
description: The SEARCH state (design bible §3): with the central room cleared, the Corridor B archer sees the player through the room's south doorway; the player steps west behind the south wall and leaves through the west doorway into Corridor A. The archer walks to the last-seen spot, looks around for 3.5 s, gives up and walks back to its post. The archer is used because, at 1.5 m/s, the player is out of sight and range before it reaches the spot, where a levy at 4.6 m/s would keep it in sight.
